_about: Denah, Valentine (131140, dark_psygirl_vt23): translated from the game's Japanese. Global terms: Denah Selphis, King/Lord of Void and Darkness, Valentine's Fest, Sonia (brown_fighter), Parfait (monster_cook), Nimbus, Yuki Mishima, Shota Inori (Shou), Mr. Producer.
profile: Yin and yang, black and white. Chaos inverts, and the maiden clads herself in a world of white-- In other words, cute white outfits aren't Denah's style, but she's adopting one as a new look anyway.
titleCondition: Level Denah to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/fu_wagaouni: Heh... My King has no blind spots. Every festival shall descend into chaos-- ...Hmm, no, that's not it, is it~? Shibuya style is a bit quieter, right?
speech.home/hateomita: ...I saw the end. The King from beyond who dwells on the other side. What I received was a pact and strength. The will to stay true to myself. --So if I don't like something, I'll take down even my King. ...Just kidding!
speech.home/hei_yukichan: Hey, Yuki! Wanna go clothes shopping with me? I mean, your world was really interesting. I want to know more about it!
speech.home/iyane_chigaundayo: No, see, it's not like that??? It's not like cute clothes are completely off-limits?? I get that this is nice in its own way, okay? It's just, if it were at least... black...!!
speech.home/nankasa_kono: You know, things have been weird since I put on this outfit. Like my power's been inverted? My King and I were always better at destroying things. Maybe my power's closer to the Shibuya folks' after all?
speech.home/nee_kiiteyo: Hey, listen, Alk, Sonia~! So after all that, something like a religion worshipping me almost got started, okay? ...Romance really is better when it's wholesome!
speech.ally/join: Ah! Wait! I said wait! I'm not ready yeeet!! Ugh...!! *ahem* Chaos inverts, dyed in white. That's me this time! Got a problem with that!?
speech.ally/evolution: You and me, and everyone else too. Together, we can do anything! I mean it, okay? I'd even swear it on my King! Because I love you all!

1.title: Chaos Inverted
1.summary: Taking an interest in Valentine's Fest, Denah plots to use it as an excuse to get new clothes. With Yuki and the others' help, she changes into a sweet white outfit unlike her usual style, and everyone gets excited coming up with a new catchphrase to match it.

lines.13: Huh? Denah, you don't know about Valentine's Fest?
lines.18: Ahh~! I've heard there's a custom like that up north in my world too. Sounds fun!
lines.21: Then it's settled... Heh heh heh, preparations are in order...!
lines.25: A festival calls for suitable attire, does it not? For I am the maiden of the King of Void and Darkness! A maiden, I say!!
lines.29: Aren't you just making up an excuse because you want new clothes...?
lines.36: Heh, just you watch! I'll show you a new form befitting a festival swirling with love...!
lines.40: And holding an unveiling for it is just so Denah...
lines.56: I helped too! She said she wanted to bring in some Shibuya sense or whatever!
lines.59: ...Except she and Yuki ended up getting all into it together and kicked me out, y'know???
lines.70: Nooooooo!!! I don't wanna show them!! This totally doesn't suit me!!!
lines.74: Hmm... I think it looks good, but... should we call it off, then? If you really hate it, you don't have to force yourself.
lines.79: I don't want that either! I don't wanna cause trouble for Alk and the others or the person who made it!!
lines.82: ...Then let's go together. You can hide behind me at first. Come on!
lines.95: I-I am Denah... Selphis! Be dyed in the darkness... wh-white? ...of my King!!
lines.99: I think I might be done for...
lines.103: Wait, it's cute...? What, is she going for the gap...?? Huh...?
lines.109: It is cute. Yes. Truly. It is cute.
lines.114: That's exactly the problem!!! This isn't my style!! It's white!! It's way too sweet!!!
lines.119: Huh? Why? It's awesome. It's like an angel or something, right? Might even beat an idol, no?
lines.125: Gyaaah!! The worst possible reaction!! I'm taking it off!!!

lines.145: The world of these clothes... Hmm...?
lines.148: ...W-Well, it's true that in Shibuya's manga, people like me usually wear clothes covered in frills...?
lines.152: Besides, I think you could make these clothes look cool, Denah.
lines.156: Could I? Now that you mention it, maybe...?
lines.160: Hmm, no, but my usual catchphrases don't really fit the vibe...

lines.168: Alright, I'm ready anytime! You're up, Sho!
lines.171: Heh, are you sure? Touch me, and you'll get burned.
lines.181: Hmm... It's definitely chuuni. But is it the right direction...?
lines.185: Hmmm... Honestly, I don't hate it, but I don't think it fits this outfit~?
lines.198: Next up, Alk! You've got an idea, right?
lines.202: I have to do it too!? Ugh... Hmm... I don't have powers like you two.
lines.206: If we're matching Denah's current vibe, I think it'd have to be something more delicate.
lines.217: --Beyond the deep darkness. Are you there?
lines.226: Right, right! That's a keeper! Come on, you've totally got it in you! As expected of Alk, my compass!
lines.231: That's a new kind of compliment...
lines.235: Now then, the main event, Yuki! Are you ready...?
lines.240: Kind of, I guess. I think I figured it out a bit watching Ayumu.

lines.270: Um, having it explained is kind of embarrassing...!
lines.274: Come on, everyone, help me think! We've gotta remix that to fit me! You two were on such a roll!

2.title: An End for Just the Two of Us, Once Longed For
2.summary: After receiving chocolates from her guy friends, Denah gets a love confession from an apprentice pâtissier. She dodges it on the spot and asks Alk and the others for advice, only to meet the man again after he's made a wildly misguided resolution--leaving her lamenting that she's had enough.

lines.5: Wahh, this is delicious! What is this, chocolate liqueur!? That's amazing! Is it for Valentine's Fest?
lines.8: Right~? It's my masterpiece! It's been pretty popular, too!
lines.10: Some weird sheep showed up and caused a ruckus last year, but we all made it here safe and sound. So this is a little chocolate from me to celebrate.
lines.12: Oh, is that how it's going? Then here's my chocolate. It's an assortment from a shop that's been popular lately.
lines.14: Ah, then here's mine. The manager set it aside especially for me.
lines.17: Huh, these are for me? I can have them?
lines.20: Of course, of course! Keep coming back to our shop~
lines.24: Huh~? Oh my, what do I do~! I'm so popular!
lines.28: Then I'll gladly take them! I'll swing by all your shops sometime! Thanks~!
lines.33: Um, this one's from me. Not from the shop... It's... something I made myself!

lines.49: ...I'll gratefully accept this. However, my heart belongs to my King.

lines.83: I don't think I've ever heard the word "interpret" used for an answer to a confession...
lines.87: But he's your friend, right, Denah? Maybe if you gave it a try, you'd turn out to be a good match...
lines.92: You mean try dating him, right? Tell me that's what you mean!? Even that's a bit too high-level for me!?
lines.95: I mean, look. This is a really, really serious question.
lines.98: What are you supposed to do when the mood turns like that...?
lines.108: Don't make that face! Serious talks are important, right!? For both of us! You're hopeless at this stuff too!
lines.112: Hmm~? Excuse me? Is this harassment~?
lines.115: Besides, were you even interested in romance in the first place, Denah...?
lines.120: I am!? How rude!! I am... I am, yeah, I am...!?
lines.129: ...Back then... maybe... I was, I think. Like, the only one who understood me after I became the enemy of the whole world...?
lines.131: But I can't remember how I felt back then... Was that... my youth...?
lines.136: Heh heh. You really are cute, Denah.
lines.140: Enough already, forget my old stories! They're kinda embarrassing!
lines.143: More importantly, look, there's a guy here who's full of those kinds of stories!
lines.152: Yes, yes, my stories have nothing to do with what you're going to do, Denah.
lines.155: I'm not in the habit of meddling in other people's love lives. Don't turn this on me--talk about your own situation.

lines.165: Huh~? If it's that kind of story, I'm sure I'm better at it, though?

lines.184: Huh!? Nimbus, you've got something like that!? Tell me, tell me!!
lines.188: Reuniting with an old friend in another world...!? That's a total love romance...!

lines.213: No, I don't need that kind of resolve!! Seven or eight years ago, my heart might've skipped a beat, but!!
lines.217: Wh-Wh-What do I do!? This is bad, right!? This is really bad, right!?
lines.237: I've had it with Valentine's Fest~!!!!

3.title: Together
3.summary: Realizing she never gave chocolate to her beloved King, Denah hits it off with Parfait, who suddenly shows up, and they start making chocolate together. After securing ingredients at sea and completing a seafood tentacle chocolate, Denah lectures her bewildered King while laughing alongside Alk and the others.

lines.11: ...Huh... Wait... What are you saying...? You can't do that...?
lines.15: It's not about whether my King eats chocolate. Showing your devotion is what matters.
lines.19: Make a chocolate that looks super King-like, then decorate it and worship it! You know, the thing. Supporting your favorite.
lines.23: I'm pretty sure that's not it...!

lines.92: Isn't this... heading in a bad direction...?
lines.96: ...Well, they're both fired up, so I guess we just have to go along with it? Yep, yep.
lines.100: ...You're enjoying this a little, aren't you?
lines.105: Having fun is a good thing.
lines.109: That said, I don't know enough about sea monsters either. It'll be an uncharted challenge for me too...!
lines.115: Nice, nice! Now I'm really fired up! Then first--
lines.125: Heh heh heh, here it comes! My instincts are tingling! Straight east from here!

1131140/1.19:
Yin and yang, black and white. Chaos inverts, and the maiden clads herself in a world of white--

In other words, cute white outfits aren't Denah's style, but she's adopting one as a new look anyway.

5000619/1.19:
A giant chocolate of indescribable shape, embodying Denah's devotion to her King, produced by the monster chef Parfait. It tastes good, but the smell of the seashore is its one flaw.

Perhaps overwhelmed by its sheer presence and mass, the King's tentacles trembled in bewilderment.
